title: Assessment and Care Plan Timeliness Standards for Care Management
content:
Care Management timeliness is measured from two dates: the member's consent, which starts the clock for the initial assessment, and the initial assessment, which starts the clock for the care plan. The schedule below sets each tier's figures.

## Assessment timeliness

| Care Management tier | Initial assessment completed within (calendar days after consent) | Reassessment every (months) | Social needs screening part of the assessment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Healthy Living Support | 30 | 12 | No |
| Care Coordination Level 1 | 30 | 12 | Yes |
| Care Coordination Level 2 | 30 | 6 | Yes |
| Maternal Care Management | 14 | 3 | Yes |
| Complex Case Management | 30 | 6 | Yes |
| Health Home Services | 30 | 6 | Yes |
| LTSS Service Coordination | 15 | 12 | Yes |

## Care plan timeliness

| Care Management tier | Care plan completed within (calendar days after the initial assessment) | Care plan review every (calendar days) | Member signature required before the plan takes effect | Copy to the member within (calendar days after signature) | Connection to a community resource confirmed within (calendar days after the referral) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Healthy Living Support | 0 | 0 | No | 0 | 0 |
| Care Coordination Level 1 | 30 | 180 | Yes | 7 | 30 |
| Care Coordination Level 2 | 30 | 90 | Yes | 7 | 30 |
| Maternal Care Management | 14 | 30 | Yes | 7 | 14 |
| Complex Case Management | 30 | 90 | Yes | 7 | 14 |
| Health Home Services | 30 | 90 | Yes | 7 | 14 |
| LTSS Service Coordination | 30 | 90 | Yes | 7 | 14 |

## Notes

- A 0 in the care plan and review columns means no care plan is written in that tier; Healthy Living Support is the one tier with no care plan.
- A 0 in the community resource column means the figure does not apply.
- The community resource figure counts calendar days after a community resource referral, by which the team confirms the connection.

## Hypothetical dates

A hypothetical Maternal Care Management member consents on 2 April. The initial assessment is due within 14 calendar days, by 16 April. If that assessment is completed on 10 April, the care plan is due within 14 calendar days of it, by 24 April; the member signs it on 22 April and a copy reaches the member within 7 calendar days, by 29 April. Reassessment follows every 3 months and the care plan is reviewed every 30 calendar days.

The same dates for a hypothetical LTSS Service Coordination member consenting on 2 April give an initial assessment due by 17 April (15 days) and, from an assessment on 10 April, a care plan due by 10 May (30 days).
